invariants.rationale: Methods returning Option<T> typically never return null, but always Option.empty() or Option.of(t).
Parameter 'instantTime' is required for scheduling compaction, so it should never be null.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is needed by ScheduleCompactionActionExecutor, so it should never be null at method exit.
Option types are expected to be non-null references, representing either empty or present.
This invariant is always true for Option (covers exhaustive possibility for return).
